name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
detailed_description:
Elfie: A Sand Plan is a cute and short puzzle game. You'll meet Elfie, a small rotund elephant. She has quite a few sand castle ideas in mind but she needs your help to build them! And with no predetermined solutions, you can take your time and enjoy solving each in the way you like!

Follow her instructions! 📜🐘💬

Using her perspective-based instructions, place the right sand blocks in the correct spots to match her vision.

Features 🏖️

  • Simple controls: Whether you are using a mouse or a touchscreen, the controls require only simple movements and inputs.

  • Simple mechanics: Intuitive gameplay that is easy to understand just by playing a few early levels.

  • Creative Mode: Get through enough levels to unlock a mode where you will be able to use all the blocks to create your own sand castles.

  • Cozy Summer Vibes: With cute music and colorful aesthetic, let it immerse you in a perfect beach day!

  • Educational: Shapes and perspective puzzles perfectly suited for younger players!

  • Outfits: Elfie is a stylish elephant! Unlock her different swimsuits as you progress through the levels.

  • Elfie: She's so cute. A feature in itself!

Dev Team & About 💻🐘🎼🐘💨

Hello! Pressed Elephant is a small team of 2 composed of a developer and a music composer.

We are currently working on Elfie and A Sand Plan was a minigame created as part of Elfie's minigame collection. As development progressed (and with some scope creep), we decided to have a standalone version for it.

We hope you enjoy this cute puzzle game and introduction to our little friend's world!

short_description: A perfect day at the beach requires sand castles. Help a small ambitious elephant with her ideas in this relaxing geometric puzzle game! Or enjoy building your own!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3+
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3+
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Both (Note: Further testing on Intel chips required.)
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3+
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Are single buttons mouse still a thing? In any case, right click is used to pause easily so having it enabled is useful.
